shortDescription: Compress file or directory as zip archive on the Windows node

options.name: dest
options.description: Destination path of zip file (provide absolute path of zip file on the target node).

options.name: src
options.description: File or directory path to be zipped (provide absolute path on the target node). When a directory path the directory is zipped as the root entry in the archive. Specify C(\*) to the end of I(src) to zip the contents of the directory and not the directory itself.
